source_summary: Vertical ink landscape with a massive textured mountain descending along the left side, a pale misty distance to the right, and a lower garden-village compound among pines, bamboo, leafless trees, rocks, water, and a small bridge. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_craggy_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the upper portion of the left mountain: rounded crags and stacked ridges rising from the left edge, with dense ink texture and small dark shrub clusters on ledges. Exclude nearby calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: layered contour linework wrapping around rounded rock forms
dry-brush hemp-fiber texture strokes
dark stippled vegetation along ridge tops and crevices
soft gray wash transitions on rock faces
irregular silhouette of the summit and side ridges

motifs.name: middle_slab_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the central descending mountain section with long vertical faces, diagonal shelf-like rock slabs, and dark brushy vegetation clinging to cracks. Avoid the red seals along the left margin and the village trees below.
must_preserve: long vertical ink streaks suggesting cliff faces and runoff
angular pale rock shelves with dark outlines
dense black scrub texture in crevices
alternating wet wash and dry-brush passages
broken edges where the cliff dissolves into mist

motifs.name: misty_right_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the faint distant peak and atmospheric wash on the right side of the composition, including the pale vertical mountain silhouette emerging from open mist. Exclude inscriptions and seals.
must_preserve: very pale gray wash silhouette
soft feathered mist edges
subtle vertical peak form
low-contrast tonal transitions
empty surrounding air that gives the peak distance

motifs.name: left_pine_studio_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left pine grove and studio area: dark full-needled pines, twisting trunks, a small architectural platform or study nook with railing, and the shaded rocks and terrace immediately around it.
must_preserve: dense pine-needle dot clusters and short bristle strokes
gnarled pale trunks outlined in ink
small railings and geometric architectural lines
bench or table-like interior detail
contrast between dark foliage masses and pale courtyard ground

motifs.name: central_walled_courtyard
motifs.description: Isolate the central village/courtyard compound with tiled roofs, enclosing walls, gate-like fence panels, vertical tree trunks, and the small robed figure standing inside the courtyard.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry with repeated diagonal tile hatching
straight wall and gate panel linework
small scholar figure with robe outline
slender tree trunks rising through the compound
pale open courtyard wash separating buildings and figures

motifs.name: right_bamboo_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side vegetation group: bamboo thickets, leafless branch sprays, dark leafy trees, and tall trunks framing the courtyard edge. Exclude the red seals at the far right.
must_preserve: fine bamboo leaf clusters with repeated narrow strokes
leafless twig networks drawn with thin ink lines
dark rounded foliage masses built from stippling
multiple tree trunks with knotted bases
layering of bamboo behind heavier trees

motifs.name: right_bank_footbridge
motifs.description: Isolate the small wooden footbridge or plank crossing at the lower right bank, including the short rail-like boards, stepped planks, adjacent rock lip, and waterline immediately around it.
must_preserve: parallel plank lines and short cross-strokes
small stepped bridge geometry
thin waterline strokes beside the landing
rock contour supporting the bridge
delicate scale contrast against the surrounding shore

motifs.name: foreground_river_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground river surface with scattered rocks and low banks across the bottom: rippling horizontal water lines, rounded ink-washed stones, and the larger central and left bank rocks. Exclude border marks and seals.
must_preserve: horizontal ripple lines across the water
rounded stones with dark dry-brush texture
large central rock with pale top plane and dark base
left bank rock mass with layered contour strokes
soft washes indicating shallow water around rock edges

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
